lead: Movable furniture and storage for the home, organised by what it does (seating, tables, beds, storage, organisers); mainstream pieces are trimmed to market-covering ranges and test winners, while design classics follow designer archetype → licensed maker/vintage/replica, and craft and period furniture is linked to the traditions register.

b.v: kiln-dried hardwood, corner-blocked, dowelled or jointed > stapled softwood or particleboard
b.w: Sofas and armchairs are judged from the inside out, frame first.

b.v: eight-way hand-tied springs > sinuous springs > webbing
b.w: The spring system comes after the frame.

b.v: high-density foam, 1.8 lb per cubic foot or more
b.w: Foam density sets how the seat holds up.

b.v: 100,000+ severe contract > 40,000+ contract > 25,000-40,000 heavy domestic > 15,000-25,000 general domestic > 10,000-15,000 light domestic > under 10,000 decorative

b.v: 5-10 years
